build_gp_regression_model: build a Gaussian Process regression model extending SimpleGP with a custom forward method
create_prior_random_variables: create prior random variables from a GP model using make_prior_random_variables for inference
sample_from_gp_prior: sample from a GP model prior using bm_sample_from_prior with a random variable mapping
run_nuts_inference: run NUTS MCMC inference on GP model queries using GlobalNoUTurnSampler with observed data
load_samples_into_gp: load posterior samples back into the GP model using pyro_load_from_samples for prediction
